name: Proceed to further evidence investigation
description: Collect additional evidence to address unresolved uncertainties and knowledge gaps before a scientific decision.

name: Proceed to focused hypothesis evaluation
description: Evaluate a defined scientific hypothesis using additional targeted evidence and appropriate validation.

name: Hold pending contradiction or evidence resolution
description: Pause decision progression when evidence conflicts, uncertainty, or missing information requires resolution.

name: Escalate for expert scientific review
description: Route the decision context to a qualified human reviewer when evidence or consequences require expert assessment.
